item.title: 👤 Content Creator 📍 Remote 💼 YZi Labs Key Responsibilities Create engaging conte
item.description:
👤 Content Creator
📍 Remote
💼 YZi Labs

Key Responsibilities

Create engaging content for social media platforms, including X (Twitter), Telegram, and other relevant channels.

Research and cover Web3 trends, blockchain projects, DeFi, AI, digital assets, and emerging technologies.

Write educational articles, market insights, project analyses, and ecosystem updates.

Develop content strategies to increase audience engagement and brand awareness.

Adapt content to different platforms and international audiences.

Collaborate with marketing and ecosystem teams on campaigns, announcements, and promotional materials.

Monitor industry developments and identify relevant topics and content opportunities.

Track content performance and optimize publishing strategies based on audience engagement.

Requirements

2+ years of experience in content creation, copywriting, journalism, or social media within Web3, blockchain, or crypto.

Strong understanding of blockchain technology, DeFi, crypto markets, and Web3 ecosystems.

Excellent writing and storytelling skills.

Experience creating content for X (Twitter), Telegram, Medium, or similar platforms.

Ability to research complex topics and communicate them in an accessible and engaging way.

Familiarity with crypto communities, market trends, and emerging Web3 projects.

Ability to work independently, manage deadlines, and maintain consistent content quality.

Good written communication skills in English; additional languages are a plus.

📞 Contact: @yunayuyyu
